model.name: Blue Archive-like Spark
model.blurb: A 0.7% pickup rate, 3% chance of a 3-star, and a 200-point spark. A natural pickup does not reset the meter.
model.source: Based on Blue Archive's published rates (3% for a 3-star, 0.7% pickup, 120 pyroxene) and its pre-5.5 Recruitment Points spark at 200. Dual banners shared points. At a banner's end, points converted to keystones and did not carry over.
notes: Pickup is 0.7% on its own, not half of all 3-stars. Given a 3-star, the pickup is about 23.3%.
Each pull adds one Recruitment Point. At 200 points, you can trade them for the pickup. A natural pickup does not reset the meter.
On a dual banner, getting pickup A early still leaves enough points to spark B at 200. JP 5.5 replaced that system.
The spark is a shop purchase. Global still used this system when JP introduced Recruitment Charge; JP used it until 29 July 2026.

overview.summary: A character model that combines random recruitment with an accumulated point exchange.
overview.distinctive: Natural featured rewards preserve progress toward the exchange.
overview.strength: The exchange gives repeated recruitment a predictable reward route.
overview.analysis: Test exchange cost, extra copies and progress lost at a banner boundary.
